nodes.name: GD - Search Folders
nodes.notes: Every client folder under the root Lead Magnet Drive folder - one iteration of the loop below per client.

nodes.name: GD - Search File
nodes.notes: Finds this client's copied spreadsheet inside its folder (named the same as the folder). Its resolved id is referenced by name (not $json) from every Sheets node below, since some of those are dead-end branches that don't sit directly downstream of this node.

nodes.name: IF - Client Sheet Found?
nodes.notes: Guards against a client folder that has no matching spreadsheet inside it yet - skips straight back to the outer loop instead of every Sheets node below erroring on an empty documentId.

nodes.name: GS - Read All Leads
nodes.notes: Deliberately a dead-end branch off GD - Search File (not the trigger), referenced by name from CODE - Compute Daily Summary. Previously chained sequentially (Leads -> Activity_Log -> Errors -> Config): if any one returned 0 rows (e.g. a brand-new client with no leads yet), every downstream node - including the whole report - would silently never run. Config is now the only node feeding the code node directly, since it is guaranteed non-empty. Re-runs fresh once per client folder via the outer Loop Over Items loop.

nodes.name: GS - Update Dashboard
nodes.notes: One row per day, upserted on 'date' so a same-day re-trigger (e.g. manual test run) updates the existing row instead of duplicating it. Reads directly from CODE - Format Summary Text (not after the Gmail node) so it always reflects the exact same numbers as the emailed summary, and isn't affected by Gmail's send-node output truncating the input fields.

value.details: ={{JSON.stringify({ date: $('CODE - Format Summary Text').first().json.date, new_submissions: $('CODE - Format Summary Text').first().json.new_submissions, a_leads: $('CODE - Format Summary Text').first().json.a_leads, b_leads: $('CODE - Format Summary Text').first().json.b_leads, c_leads: $('CODE - Format Summary Text').first().json.c_leads, overdue_next_actions: $('CODE - Format Summary Text').first().json.overdue_next_actions, errors_requiring_attention: $('CODE - Format Summary Text').first().json.errors_requiring_attention })}}
